description: This file contains utility functions for dictionary merging, filtering, mapping, nested updates, and grouping, specifically for use within the PyTorch FX unification experimental module.

methods.name: _get_factory
methods.description: Retrieves a factory function from kwargs, defaulting to dict, raises TypeError if unexpected kwargs are present.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges multiple dictionaries with later dictionaries taking precedence.

methods.name: merge_with
methods.description: Merges dictionaries and applies a function to combined values for each key.

methods.name: valmap
methods.description: Applies a function to all values in a dictionary.

methods.name: keymap
methods.description: Applies a function to all keys in a dictionary.

methods.name: itemmap
methods.description: Applies a function to each item (key-value pair) in a dictionary.

methods.name: valfilter
methods.description: Filters dictionary items by value based on a predicate.

methods.name: keyfilter
methods.description: Filters dictionary items by key based on a predicate.

methods.name: itemfilter
methods.description: Filters dictionary items by item (key-value pair) based on a predicate.

methods.name: assoc
methods.description: Returns a new dictionary with a specified key set to a value.

methods.name: dissoc
methods.description: Returns a new dictionary with specified keys removed.

methods.name: assoc_in
methods.description: Returns a new dictionary with a nested key path set to a value.

methods.name: update_in
methods.description: Updates a value in a nested dictionary at a specified key path using a function.

methods.name: get_in
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a nested data structure given a list of keys.

methods.name: getter
methods.description: Returns an itemgetter function based on the provided index or list of indices.

methods.name: groupby
methods.description: Groups a collection by a key function or member.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first element of a sequence.
